evidence: We have reported correlations between low energy electron diffraction (LEED) reconstruction phases and surface compositions of 13SIC(001), (2 x 1) and c(4 x 2) phases have a full silicon top layer, whereas the c(2 x 2) phase has a full carbon top layer. The (3 x 2) and (5 x 2) phases have additional dimer rows on top of a silicon-terminated crystal. After this treatment, a sharp c(2 x 2) LEED pattern was always observed at room temperature. The AES energy analyser was set at a relatively shallow angle (24 ° ) from the horizontal axis of the sample so that the signals detected were more surface sensitive.
